report_name: Heart of America Medical Center Data Breach Exposes Patient SSNs and Medical Records

threat_actors.name: Embargo
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that conducted a double-extortion attack against Heart of America Medical Center, encrypting systems and exfiltrating 800 gigabytes of patient data including SSNs and medical records.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Embargo ransomware group encrypted hospital systems for extortion.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The Embargo group stole 800 GB of patient data, likely uploading it to a cloud service they controlled.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The Embargo group likely used valid accounts for initial access and lateral movement after stealing credentials.

attack_patterns.name: System Network Connections Discovery
attack_patterns.description: The Embargo group likely performed network discovery to map the internal network and identify high-value targets like file servers and domain controllers.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The Embargo group likely deleted volume shadow copies using tools like vssadmin to prevent system recovery from local backups.

attack_patterns.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: The Embargo group likely disabled security tools like antivirus/EDR to evade detection during the attack.

malware.name: Embargo
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the Embargo group to encrypt systems at Heart of America Medical Center as part of a double-extortion attack.

tools.name: rclone
tools.description: Legitimate data synchronization tool likely abused by the Embargo group for bulk data exfiltration of 800 GB of patient data.

identities.name: Heart of America Medical Center
identities.description: A critical access hospital in Rugby, North Dakota, that was the victim of a double-extortion ransomware attack by the Embargo group, resulting in the exposure of patient SSNs and medical records.

infrastructure.name: Embargo Exfiltration Host
infrastructure.description: Cloud-based infrastructure controlled by the Embargo group used to store the 800 GB of exfiltrated patient data.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a90-8bcd-ef1234567890
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware precursor technique to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.claimdepot.com/data-breach/heart-of-america-medical-center-2026
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-07
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware precursor technique to inhibit system recovery.
